title: Recall Note
description: The RECALL-stage exit artifact (the M⇐D seam, read side). Output of recall.py / the machine-side /recall. Records what System D was asked and what it answered BY REFERENCE ONLY: each citation is a slug + content sha + section + a short 'supports' note. There is deliberately NO field for the DB page body — the recall_note never inlines System-D content into the run-store (blueprint §5; evidence-contract). A citation requires a non-empty slug + sha (no invented slug — evidence-contract clause 4). allOf: a non-silent recall must carry >=1 citation; a silent recall carries an optional 'closest' pointer instead.

citations.description: By-reference citations into System D. Empty iff vault_silent. NEVER contains the DB page body.

slug.description: A lowercase-kebab slug that EXISTS in System-D index.md (never invented).

sha256.description: Content hash of the cited DB page at recall time (the 'by reference, with sha' anchor).

section.description: Optional §heading within the page the citation points at.

supports.description: Optional short note on how this page supports the answer — a pointer, NOT a copy of the page body.

vault_silent.description: true when System D has nothing on the topic (recall must say so explicitly, never fabricate).

closest.description: For a silent recall: the closest existing page + how it differs.
